title: What Does 10 Need?
objective: For any number up to 10, name how many more are needed to reach 10 — the single most important fact family for Unit 1.3.
newIdea: Complements to 10 — moving the complements-to-5 idea from 5 to 10.

teaching.setup: A ten-frame with 7 filled (the exact case Unit 1.3 uses first).
teaching.see: How many empty spaces are left?
teaching.break: Subitize or count the 3 empty spaces.
teaching.transform: The same 7, described as itself or as 3 away from 10.

check.prompt: Fill the empty spaces and count all 10.

examples.transfer: 9 needs 1 and 6 needs 4, in the same sitting.

mastery.evidence: States the complement to 10 correctly for at least 7 of 9 numbers 1-9.
